title: King C. Gillette Double Edge Safety Razor + 5 Razor Blades $14.94 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Chemist Warehouse
body:
Deal: King C. Gillette Double Edge Safety Razor + 5 Razor Blades $14.94 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Chemist Warehouse

[HaydosK] This is the normal sale price for chemist warehouse. The best price you can find it at unless you find it on clearance. I recommend this one over anything else you can find at the retail stores.
[BrewerHaHa] Agreed, pretty good for the price and better value than my Merkur. Merkur was $45 when I bought it, I get a 10-20% better shave. If you like this it might be worth the upgrade to Merkur given these literally last forever but there’s also nothing wrong with sticking to this forever either
[shreav] My shaves weren't good enough before.
Since I bought it, I can confidently say this safety razor put a handle on it.
[MILKAPIG] Got this and find it good
Need find good razor blades though to pair with it
[dudleydoright] I like to use Feather razors, along with Proraso shaving soap and aftershave lotion. The shaving soap is surprisingly impactful to the quality of the shave.
[Lizard Spock] This razor just didn't work for me. But I finally found a use for the blades. Used it to make the cuts on my sourdough . Much better than a Stanley knife.
[87percent] Does any electric shaver users use a gel or anything when they shave?
[FullPricePhobic] Sometimes I use gel foam if I want a close(ish) shave. Mostly dry though.
[whitelie] Tried it a few times, I felt like a got a better quality (closer) shave using it but most of the time I can't be bothered
[AlsoChris] never looked back since swapping from 4/5 blades
[gurgle166] Buying one now, thanks. My old QShave $7 aliexpress POS died because the steel threading wore out (lol), my first DE razor. This one should be a good, cheap replacement. I started out by buying a variety pack from Connaught Shaving and found Gillette Silver Blue the best, I swear by it. I bought some Gillette Platinums by accident and immediately felt they were not good for me before realising that actually it was the Silver Blues I liked, not the Platinums, I had gotten confused.
Of course everyone's experience will differ because their technique, hair, and skin are different. But I vouch for the GSBs.
